title: The Confidence-Man: His Masquerade
author: Herman Melville
description: "The Confidence-Man: His Masquerade" by Herman Melville is a novel published in 1857.
longDescription: Set aboard a Mississippi River steamboat on April Fool's Day, the story follows mysterious figures who may be the same man in disguise.

authorInfo.bio: Herman Melville was an American writer of the American Renaissance period. Among his best-known works are Moby-Dick (1851), Typee (1846), a romanticized account of his experiences in Polynesia, and Billy Budd, Sailor, a posthumously published novella. At the time of his death, Melville was not well known to the public, but 1919, the centennial of his birth, was the starting point of a Melville revival.
